about_the_game:
Urgent Message: Evacuate is a pixel-art, top-down shooter that combines elements of search, treasure hunting, and evacuation. Players enter a post-apocalyptic wasteland as a special forces operative in distress. During a secret mission, an unexpected incident causes you to lose contact with your squad, and you're left with a new objective: evacuate.

Throughout this perilous evacuation, players will face various challenges, including enemy ambushes, resource shortages, and life-or-death decisions. As the mission progresses, you'll uncover the true secrets behind the mission's failure, realizing that everything is part of a meticulously planned conspiracy.

Key Features:

  • Single-player and multiplayer co-op gameplay

  • Linear story, immersive experience

  • Character progression and weapon system, customizable development

    The game is currently in early development. Thank you all for your attention and support! 🙂
